reason: Researched with WebSearch and WebFetch: re-ranked the cross-section on Finviz sector and SPDR ETF performance through the 10-23 close and checked the macro tape. The book entered 10-19 is up on six of seven legs (XLE +2.3%, XLP +1.2%, XLV +2.1% long; XLI +1.2%, XLY +1.2%, XLC +4.2% short; only the XLRE short is -2.2%), every leg well inside its stop. Friday's staples -1.7% and health care weakness were a one-day Dow-led selloff on a day the Nasdaq held, not a ranking change. Next week brings the 10-28 FOMC (hold expected, December hike ~71% priced), GDP, core PCE and the MSFT/GOOGL/AMZN prints; the book is cross-sectional and 40% cash, so it is not a directional bet on any of them. Re-registering a one-week-old book with an unchanged ranking would be churn with no signal behind it. Round 3 novelty check versus my Round 2 book: the only same-direction overlap is XLE (8% there, 12% here), far below the 50% limit.
